question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**ahead**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ahead means **in front** of someone or somebody.

 
 
• **Example:** *Sam was standing **ahead** of Mike in the queue.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the word filling the blank should mean **being in the front or being better **than others. 
 
• Other similar words given in the option like **'front**' and '**forward**' show only the **side** whereas "**ahead**" denotes a **position**. 
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate answer is "ahead". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Front** - the side of an object that is most visible. 

 
 
• **Example**: *The **front** side of the building was like a castle.*
 
 
 
• **Forward** - moving towards the front.
 
 
• **Example**: *The students were asked to push their benches **forward.** *
 
 
 
• **Away** - being at a distance or not present at the moment.
 
 
• **Example**: *Mary will be **away** from the town for a week. *
